title: Generated waiting queues: which case do the written ordering rules put at the asked position?
decision: which of five listed cases of a waiting queue the numbered ordering rules of the state put at the position asked for

source.name: generator build/gen_triage_order.py
source.version: gen_v4, 2026-10-08: consistent times (no appointment before its arrival, workshop pickup not before check-in + bench time), no class-first shortcut (level 1: class is rule 1 in every rule set; levels 2-3: capped at one member per group and 25 % of the items)

licence: generated by the benchmark's script (no third-party text)
notes: 600 items = 3 levels x (66 groups of three + 1 group of two); 200 items per level. The members of a group share one queue and differ in ONE element (current time, one flag, one arrival time, one class at level 1, or the position asked for) and have different answers among the same five options (five ticket ids of the queue: the answers of the members and the answers of plausible misreadings, recorded in meta.option_roles). Gold option place balanced exactly (40 per place and level); the row of the gold case in the listing balanced over the fifths of the list. meta.deviation is the planted kind of the group (all members), meta.variant 0 marks the base member. Truth computed twice (sort key and pairwise duels). State characters per level min/median/max: L1 907/1102/1231; L2 1810/2256/2786; L3 2313/2773/3378. gen_v4 fixes: no time column contradicts another (appointment never before arrival, workshop pickup never before check-in + bench time, asserted on the text of every state); the class-first shortcut is excluded (level 1: class is rule 1 in every rule set, the top class has at least two cases and the other tie-break never gives the key, no class column is shown without a rule that uses it; levels 2-3: the shortcut gives the key in at most one member of a group and in at most 25 % of the items).
skill: apply ordered priority rules with class adjustments (waiting limit, flag, floor at class 1, cumulative or not) and tie-breaks to a queue, then read off a position
knobs: cases 6 / 9-10 / 12-14; level 1 rule sets class-arrival / class-ticket / class-arrival-ticket; rules 2-3 / 4 / 5-6; class adjustments 0 / 1 / 2 (cumulative or not); position asked 1 / 1-2 / 1-3; limit W 20-90 min with half of the waits within 3 min of W; appointments due on the minute; 3 table layouts x 2 block orders
